"import csv
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt

# Read the CSV data
data = []
with open('load_02.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        data.append(row)

# Parse data
records = []
for row in data:
    case = row[0]
    load_factor = float(row[1])
    cycles = int(row[2])
    records.append((case, load_factor, cycles))

N = len(records)

# Compute stats
load_values = [r[1] for r in records]
cycle_values = [r[2] for r in records]
load_max = max(load_values)
load_mean = sum(load_values) / len(load_values)
total_cycles = sum(cycle_values)

# Round to source precision (load_factor appears to have 2 decimals, cycles are integers)
load_max_rounded = round(load_max, 2)
load_mean_rounded = round(load_mean, 2)

# Create document
doc = Document()

# Title
title = doc.add_heading('Engineering Test Report — Load Analysis', level=0)

# Overview
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(f'This report analyzes fatigue test data containing {N} data records from the load_02 dataset.')

# Results table
doc.add_heading('Results table', level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
table.style = 'Table Grid'
hdr = table.rows[0].cells
hdr[0].text = 'case'
hdr[1].text = 'load_factor'
hdr[2].text = 'cycles'

for case, load_factor, cycles in records:
    row = table.add_row().cells
    row[0].text = case
    row[1].text = f'{load_factor:.2f}'
    row[2].text = str(cycles)

# Summary
doc.add_heading('Summary', level=1)
summary_text = (
    f'N cases = {N}; '
    f'load max = {load_max_rounded:.2f}; '
    f'load mean = {load_mean_rounded:.2f}; '
    f'total cycles = {total_cycles}'
)
doc.add_paragraph(summary_text)

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading('Conclusion', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    'The data set shows fatigue test results across multiple load cases. '
    'All numeric values presented in this document are derived directly from '
    'the source CSV file and reported with the same precision as the source data.'
)

doc.save('report.docx')"
